title: Independent replication of ambient-pressure superconductivity above 290 K in a Y-C-S hydride
body: We report the independent synthesis of the yttrium-carbon-sulfur hydride phase described by Kwon et al. (2026) and observe zero resistance below 294 K and full diamagnetic shielding at 1 atm in 7 of 11 samples. Measurements were performed blind at three laboratories (Tsukuba, Grenoble, Urbana) on samples exchanged between groups. The specific-heat anomaly and isotope shift are consistent with a phonon-mediated mechanism. Preprint: arXiv:2610.04471.

title: Room-temperature superconductivity at ambient pressure in a yttrium-carbon-sulfur hydride
body: Kwon, Alvarez, Dube et al. We report a resistive transition at 296 K and a Meissner signal in a Y-C-S-H compound synthesised by a two-step high-pressure route and recovered to ambient conditions. Results are from a single laboratory; samples will be made available to qualified groups for verification. Preprint: arXiv:2609.11208.

title: arXiv:2609.11842 [astro-ph.EP] Biosignature retrieval on temperate sub-Neptunes: joint constraints from NIRSpec and MIRI
body:
Authors: R. Achterberg, M. Nwosu, P. Castellanos
Categories: astro-ph.EP
Abstract: We perform joint retrievals on transmission spectra of four temperate sub-Neptunes and assess the detectability of CH4-CO2 disequilibrium and sulfur-bearing biosignature gases as a function of cloud-top pressure. Ten transits are needed for a 3-sigma detection of DMS at 1 ppm under nominal hazes.

title: arXiv:2610.03377 [astro-ph.EP] Dimethyl sulfide in K2-18 b revisited: a joint NIRSpec-MIRI retrieval
body:
Authors: S. Adeyemi, L. Fortier, I. Halvorsen, D. Okonkwo
Categories: astro-ph.EP
Abstract: We re-analyse all public JWST transits of K2-18 b with a common pipeline. The DMS feature reported by Okonkwo, Beaulieu & Tran (2023) is not recovered above 2 sigma in the joint fit; the earlier result is sensitive to the choice of MIRI systematics model. A tentative 2.1-sigma preference for DMDS remains. We discuss what would constitute a robust claim.

title: RUSTSEC-2026-0143: hyper — request smuggling via chunk-extension parsing

Package: hyper
Affected: >=1.0.0, <1.7.2
Patched: 1.7.2
Severity: high (CVSS 7.5)
hyper's HTTP/1 parser accepted a chunk extension containing a bare CR, which a front proxy may treat as a line end. Upgrade to 1.7.2.
rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0143

title: sqlx 0.8.7: please upgrade if you use the Postgres driver

Reported privately, fixed in 24h, GHSA-9x4m-qf7c-2hjp requested. No API change; bump and go.
